title: Check an unhealthy release
brief: Find the affected shop Application. Read its health status and use History to identify the deployed revision.

checks.question: Which Application is unhealthy?
checks.hint: Find the shop Application for the selected environment.
checks.why: The Applications list identifies which release needs inspection.

checks.question: What health status does this Application show?
checks.hint: Read the health badge in the Application header.
checks.why: Health shows whether the deployed workload is ready.

checks.question: Which Git revision is deployed on this unhealthy service?
checks.hint: Open History and Rollback and read the latest deployed revision.
checks.why: History ties the unhealthy release to the commit Argo deployed.

truth.cause: The workload is failing its readiness probe
